fusions.name: Drifting Line
fusions.desc: Lobs a weighted line that deals 3 water damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Tow
fusions.desc: Hauls on a long, slow drag at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 30 water damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and makes the target move 40% slower for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Shallows
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Mending
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (30% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
